legal_term_relation_projection.matching: exact label; zero legal candidates excluded, one mapped, multiple held unless one reciprocal relation candidate with unique source anchor
legal_term_relation_projection.namespace: MOLEG knowledge_terms (법제처 지식용어), not the corpus-presence CORPUS_TERM (본문용어) classification
legal_term_relation_projection.relation_policy: preserve original five source codes; normalized hierarchy parent to child; preserve raw paths; hold incompatible kinds and cycles
legal_term_relation_projection.output: explicit new directory: relations.sqlite, graph.json, TSV ledgers, report.json, REPORT.md
legal_term_relation_projection.consumer: inspect/verify; explicit selected knowledge bundle -> navigation source hints; no canonical approval
legal_term_relation_projection.coverage: all existing edges in selected draft; no implicit remote collection

external_dictionary_collection.consumer: lawrag.pipeline.glossary_assembly via pipeline.py glossary assemble (econedu/nts); not connected to runtime

scoped_relation_collection.seed_policy: legal knowledge terms occurring in selected corpus

draft_assembly.consumer: glossary review; glossary_linking; document-release new-definition draft
draft_assembly.live_collection_policy: short SQLite read transaction; immutable selected response snapshot
draft_assembly.rebuild_policy: same explicit inputs with a new output directory; earlier draft preserved

definition_policy.source: quoted definition patterns in selected immutable corpus
definition_policy.scope: explicit same-clause hints only; unknown scope preserved; no inferred document-wide applicability
definition_policy.references: explicit named law/article references preserved as unreviewed hints; no inferred cross-law applicability
definition_policy.partial_sentences: preserved as CONTINUATION_REQUIRED; not passed as complete definitions
definition_policy.consumer: assemble --inspect --term; review prepare with each definition as a separate target

draft_assembly.occurrence_policy: entry_corpus_link applies to every source; MOLEG absence never removes corpus evidence

llm_execution.review: GENOS only; complete orchestrates offline prepare, bounded run, draft compile; no external fallback

llm_review.output: review.sqlite and exact provider attempts; immutable reviewed draft plus completion.json selecting the downstream authoring input
jobs: MEANING_CHECK with explicit descriptions/definitions on both sides
guards: definitions split source-scoped candidates; no automatic prose sense splitting
missing source evidence deferred without model calls
each identity and relationship selects existing evidence IDs from both definitions
system copies and verifies source text/offset/hash; no model quote field
unknown states and conflicting hierarchy preserved; no canonical membership writes
job/input/model/schema/source version bound on resume and compile
only hash-bound completion receipt selects a downstream reviewed draft
llm_review.resume: Completed jobs skipped; failed/interrupted jobs need --retry-failed. After completion retry requires a new output. Old v2 review states remain historical and cannot run under v3.
llm_review.consumer: assemble --inspect --term exposes sense assertions; build-data-stages selects the completed draft through glossary_linking.configured; original source definitions remain authoring hints
llm_review.removed: GAP_PROPOSAL and background-word candidates from dictionary descriptions
llm_review.transport_contract: API-compatible structural schema; complete length/cardinality/citation validation stays local

current_sample_state.execution: GENOS plan remains pending; external public integration result is separate

llm_review.completion_policy: One invocation processes up to max-jobs; pending returns exit 3 without publishing. Terminal failed/unknown/conflicted items remain explicit PARTIAL; valid proposals compile. Repeating completion is cached.
llm_review.acceptance: explicit user direction after ADR-0393 known model errors; not holdout quality certification

current_draft.selection: explicit authoring draft, not runtime promotion

structure_linkage.default_glossary: validated completion from current_review_state; until it exists current_draft under logical data root; --glossary-dir overrides
steps: match registered surfaces preserving source offsets
compile complete verified links into navigation-v3
structure_linkage.consumer: term_generation -> navigation-v3; document-release integrates explicit sources
structure_linkage.cache_policy: structure immutable; glossary changes rebuild links; new run ID for semantic reauthoring
structure_linkage.candidate_policy: same spelling does not approve meaning; reviewed draft retains assertions/conflicts; source-definition hints remain unapproved and bounded; lexical relationship proposals are not automatically applied as synonyms
structure_linkage.composed_build_all: complete structure; merge explicit sources; review existing pending candidates and new definitions together; compile integrated navigation-v3 and serving assets; no implicit activation

order: match existing headwords against the selected structured legal corpus
connect everyday/legal terms with typed evidence
connect legal terms to law/article coordinates
catalogue_model.classification_basis: selected corpus headword occurrence; independent of MOLEG/finance/tax provider category; not legal authority or semantic equivalence
catalogue_model.term_relations: preserve original source/target IDs, direction and relation code; endpoints classified by corpus presence; finance label correspondence remains a candidate

article_links.official_api_term_articles: not compiled into current glossary draft; collection pending in scoped state

catalogue_model.query_discovery: downstream consumer of the built glossary, not the glossary construction prerequisite
catalogue_model.document_definition_hints: optional existing corpus-derived supplement; separate document scope and provenance; not background-word extraction
catalogue_model.llm_authoring_hints: downstream document consumer only; not a substitute for glossary relationships

knowledge_bundle.consumer: glossary_linking -> complete LinkProjector -> navigation-v3; integrated serving glossary resources
knowledge_bundle.scope: all collected source ledgers, translations, mappings and relationship decisions; DRAFT observations only

document_update.consumer: build-all -> document-release build; service.py via explicit GENOS generation/CURRENT
document_update.default_glossary: current_draft; explicit completed --glossary-dir reuses previous observations
document_update.review_state: TERM_RELEASES/<run>/review; separate from standalone glossary review state

abbreviation_review.stage: after a navigation generation is built; derives a new generation
abbreviation_review.target: (term, article) links resting on a Latin abbreviation alone (2-8 chars, 2+ capitals); a longer name of the term in the article exempts the link
abbreviation_review.deterministic: abbreviation not a standalone token in the article (L P G, Cu-Ni) -> NO_STANDALONE, dropped
abbreviation_review.llm: GENOS, one job per abbreviation: candidate headwords (names + dictionary/MOLEG/bundle definition) x up to 16 article contexts; model picks candidate IDs (MATCHED), OTHER or UNKNOWN
abbreviation_review.outcome: SAME kept, DIFFERENT dropped, UNKNOWN and NOT_OFFERED kept; source generation unchanged; decisions stored in abbreviation_review

public_label_parts.scope: public glossary labels (not moleg, not corpus_definition)
public_label_parts.rule: trailing parenthetical gloss -> head + Hangul/Latin-abbreviation parts (SOURCE_LABEL_PART), English phrase (SOURCE_ENGLISH); infix parenthesis -> head only; 'old→ new' renames -> both names; hanja glosses dropped
public_label_parts.effect: new assembly generations only; existing drafts unchanged

reference_terms.rule: public glossary headword matched in a question with no article in scope and no MOLEG bridge: never an article seed; its source definition is appended to the answer as a labelled note (not evidence)
